claim: Every minimal-witness family is an antichain; any antichain on m grounded operations with maximum member size lambda obeys nu <= max_{k<=lambda} C(m,k).

verification.method: independent exhaustive enumeration of every nonempty antichain of the Boolean lattice for m=1,2,3,4; compare cardinality with the restricted Sperner bound

interpretation: Witness diversity nu is not independent of grounded support m. This is a consistency constraint, not yet a breakthrough accounting law, because Audit 340 already shows schema cardinality need not control grounded support.
